review_notes: Segment 0: Several non-verse phrases (e.g., 'बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह परित्यजति। यहा अस्मिन् लोके...') remain as in the raw transcript because wording was unclear; please verify these lines against the speaker audio for exact lexical choices.

Segment 0: Phrases like 'स्वधर्मे खे सुकर्मसु वर्तमानस्य' and 'ईश्वरार्पित चेतसा त्यक्तकौशलं कुशलभावः' were left unchanged despite possible ASR errors; confirm intended words (especially 'खे', 'त्यक्तकौशलं') with human review if precise Sanskrit wording is required.

Segment 1: Preserved Sanskrit/Hindi quotations as spoken. Possible ASR artifacts worth human review: 'हृष्टो दृप्यति' and the concatenated phrase 'हर्षामर्षभयत्यागी' — these may be mis-transcriptions of Sanskrit or compound Hindi terms and could affect interpretive meaning if altered.

Segment 2: Possible Sanskrit/technical items that may need human review because the transcript may contain mis-hearings or orthographic variants: "च्युति", "बुद्धि योगे त्विमां शृणु", "दूरेण ह्यवरं", and "बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह". I preserved the original wording where uncertain to avoid altering doctrinal meaning.

Segment 3: Several Sanskrit-phrase fragments appear uncertain or possibly garbled in the raw (e.g., the opening: "सो दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म हे धनञ्जय, कर्म सत्कर्म, दूरेण हि अवरम्।" and the cluster around "मामिच्छाप्तुम् धनञ्जय" / "अभ्यासयोगेन ततः माम् आप्तुम् इच्छ"). I preserved the spoken wording where meaning was unclear; please have a human reviewer (Sanskrit/vedanta specialist) verify these quoted/versified phrases against canonical sources.
Segment 3: Left colloquial code-switching (Hindi-English) intact except where obvious phonetic ASR renderings were normalized (e.g., 'हैव अ अम्ब्रेला' → 'have an umbrella', 'इवन'→'even').

Segment 4: Several Sanskrit quotations/phrases (for example 'यतः एवं योगविषये यायाम्', 'बुद्धौ तत्परिपाकजायां वा...', 'पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ', 'सांख्ययोगेन ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानाम्... कर्मयोगे न योगिनाम्') appear garbled or spoken with elisions in the original transcript. I preserved their raw wording rather than attempting substantive reconstruction, per guideline to avoid uncertain Sanskrit corrections.
Segment 4: Left other colloquial forms (e.g., 'बहिरंग') as in the original to preserve speaker style.

Segment 5: Several Sanskrit/technical terms were preserved as in the raw transcript but are potentially uncertain and may merit human review for exact canonical wording: "स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य। स्वधर्मो विगुणः श्रेयान्।","तत्प्राप्त्युपायभूते","बुद्धौ शरणम् अन्विच्छ","योगविषयया बुद्धौ... तत् परिपाकजायाम।","परिपाकज बुद्धि". Verify these against the original lecture audio or source notes if precise Sanskrit orthography is required.
Segment 6: The opening Sanskrit-ish phrase 'नान्यः पन्था विद्यते यनाय।' looks mis-transcribed or incomplete; left as in source. Please verify against original audio/text.
Segment 6: The term 'विदित्वा' ("विदित्वा प्राप्ति नहीं होगा") might be a mis-heard form; unsure of intended word (e.g., 'विधित्वा' or 'विन' etc.). Left as in source for fidelity—please check.
Segment 6: The word 'अवरम्' ("बोले कर्म तो बिल्कुल अवरम्") is uncertain in meaning/transcription; preserved original. Recommend human review for doctrinal accuracy.

Segment 9: Transcript contains the phrase “जीवन नेव” ("इह माने यहीं पर, जीवन नेव।") which may be an ASR distortion of a Sanskrit/Hindi term (e.g., 'जीवित नेव' / 'जीवनेव' / 'नैव'). I preserved the original wording but flag it for human review.
Segment 9: The phrase “घटस्व लिखा” appears unusual and may be an ASR error or nonstandard wording; I preserved it verbatim but recommend human verification.
Segment 10: Preserved repeated phrases (e.g., 'कहीं न कहीं न कहीं न कहीं') as spoken for emphasis; if any of these repetitions are ASR artifacts, human review can determine intended repetition.
Segment 10: Left code-switched terms like 'नेचरली', 'रीअरेंज', and 'beauty' unchanged as likely deliberate speaker code-switching; confirm if normalization is desired.
Segment 11: The change 'कुत्र' → 'कुतः' was made with medium confidence; please verify against the original audio if possible.

Segment 11: Several Sanskrit phrases (e.g., 'कर्मसु वर्तमानस्य या सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समत्वबुद्धिः', 'यद् बन्धः स्वभावान्यपि कर्माणि') were left as in the raw transcript; a human reviewer may want to confirm exact sandhi/diacritic forms if preparing a finalized editorial text.
Segment 11: Punctuation and sentence-boundary adjustments were applied throughout to reflect spoken structure; no substantive content was altered.

Segment 12: The phrase 'without perfection, that is yoga' ("without perfection, that is yoga") may be an ASR error—speaker may have intended 'with perfection'. This could change the intended mock/parodic meaning; please verify against audio.

Segment 12: The Sanskrit phrase corrected from 'बन्धनस्वभावानि, बन्धस्वभावान्यपि ...' to 'बन्धस्वभावान्यपि ...' was adjusted based on surrounding context. If precise Sanskrit wording is doctrinally important, verify against the recording.
